_doc.about: Example Cutpoint settings. Copy to <CUTPOINT_HOME>\config.json (run `cutpoint paths` to see where that is) and keep only the keys you need; every key is optional. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_doc.projects_dir: Folder for project folders. A bare project name (my-trip) or projects\<name> argument is placed here. Env CUTPOINT_PROJECTS_DIR overrides it. Default: <CUTPOINT_HOME>\projects.
_doc.source_remap: {old prefix: new prefix}. Point old paths at a new location when footage moves (another drive, a backup copy): a source under an old prefix is read from the new prefix when the file exists there. Projects and cache keys keep the original path, so nothing has to be re-analysed.
_doc.source_remap_exclude: File-name or full-path globs that are never remapped (e.g. a copy that is not verified yet).
_doc.stage_dir: Local folder for `cutpoint stage` copies of sources on slow or network storage (NAS, USB, cloud-synced folder). Env CUTPOINT_STAGE_DIR overrides it. Default: <CUTPOINT_HOME>\stage.
_doc.player_tags: Your in-game name(s) for the optional game-HUD OCR in `cutpoint events` (who killed whom). Fuzzy match, ignores _ . - and spaces. `cutpoint events --player NAME` overrides it per run. Default: none.
_doc.ollama_url: Ollama base URL for `analyze --vision` and the VLM layers of `cutpoint events`. Env OLLAMA_HOST overrides it. Default: http://127.0.0.1:11434.
_doc.vision: true or false (default). true: `cutpoint analyze` and `cutpoint edit` rate the top candidates with the vision model unless --no-vision is given (slower; uses several GB of GPU memory). false: only --vision turns it on for one run. The UI's Models tab writes it, and the UI's vision checkboxes start from it.
_doc.vision_backend: ollama (default) or assistant: assistant sends the frames of --vision and 360 director --vl-check to the assistant provider (claude-code or codex, after you agreed to it in the AI Chat) instead of Ollama. When a vision_assistant section is present, that section sets the vision role directly. See docs/configuration.md#vision_backend.
_doc.compress_peaks: off (default), light or strong: peak compression and clip leveling of `cutpoint clips`, `assemble` and `edit` when --compress-peaks is not given (see docs/commands.md#peak-compression).
_doc.color: off (default), auto or underwater: automatic color correction of `cutpoint clips` and `edit` when --color is not given (see docs/commands.md#clips). Never applied to gaming footage (only --color grades it) nor together with --lut.
_doc.analysis: {"skip": [...]}: analysis steps `cutpoint analyze` and `cutpoint edit` leave out by default; any of reactions, keyframes and crashes. --skip overrides it per run. Default: none.
_doc.video_encoder: auto, nvenc, amf, vaapi or cpu (libx264). Env CUTPOINT_VIDEO_ENCODER overrides it. auto really encodes a short test clip with each GPU encoder and uses the first that works, else libx264; a named GPU encoder that does not work is an error. `cutpoint capabilities` shows what works. Default: auto.
_doc.export_workers: auto or 1-3: how many clips `cutpoint clips` and `edit` export at once. Env CUTPOINT_EXPORT_WORKERS overrides it. auto uses 2 with a GPU encoder (nvenc, amf, vaapi) and 1 with libx264, which already uses every core; runs with a 360 clip always export one at a time. Default: auto.
_doc.assistant: Settings of the AI Chat tab of `cutpoint ui` (see docs/configuration.md#assistant). provider = ollama (default), openai (OpenAI or a server that speaks its API: LM Studio, vLLM, llama-server) or anthropic; model = model name, empty = the provider's default (Ollama: the first pulled of qwen3.5:9b, the vision model and qwen3-vl:8b, else qwen3.5:9b; Anthropic: claude-sonnet-5-5; an OpenAI-compatible server: its only model; OpenAI itself needs a name); url = base URL, empty = ollama_url, https://api.openai.com/v1 or https://api.anthropic.com; context_tokens = model context size, at least 2048, empty = 8192 for a model on this machine (and any Ollama), 32768 for a hosted one; consent = <provider>@<host> entries the user agreed to send project text to (the AI Chat tab adds them; default none). Never an API key: see environment.
_doc.pano: Optional 360-camera (Insta360) module: sdk_exe = MediaSDKTest.exe of the Insta360 Media SDK, which you apply for yourself (see docs/insta360-sdk.md; env CUTPOINT_INSTA360_SDK overrides; default: auto-detected under <CUTPOINT_HOME>\sdk\insta360\); stitch_timeout_s = kill one clip's stitch after this many seconds (default: no limit); auto_stitch = cutpoint ui exports of a 360 project first stitch the recordings they need when the SDK runs and an NVIDIA GPU is present, false exports from the dual-fisheye preview; the command-line clips never stitches (default true); stitched_dir = where `cutpoint 360 stitch` writes equirects (default <CUTPOINT_HOME>\360-stitched; about 54 GB per hour of footage); studio_dirs = folders with Insta360 Studio equirect exports (default <CUTPOINT_HOME>\360-studio); stitch_args = MediaSDKTest arguments; cmd_every = update the virtual camera every N frames (default 1; 2 halves the commands but leaves shake on every other frame); level_strength = horizon lock when stabilising, 1 = always level, 0 = follow the camera's own tilt (default 0.7); tilt_follow_s = smoothing (s) of the followed tilt (default 0.5); max_follow_deg = largest lean (deg from the clip's average attitude) the view follows; a fall or handling is followed as this much (default 30); imu_offset_s = IMU-to-video time offset in seconds (default 0); equirect_yaw_offset = yaw correction in degrees for Studio exports (default 0); default_style = --style of `cutpoint 360 analyze` when none is given (default ski).
_doc.environment: Not set here: CUTPOINT_HOME (data root), CUTPOINT_CONFIG (this file), CUTPOINT_CACHE_DIR, CUTPOINT_MODELS_DIR, CUTPOINT_TOOLS_DIR, CUTPOINT_STYLES_DIR, CUTPOINT_FFMPEG / CUTPOINT_FFPROBE, CUTPOINT_LLAMA_SERVER (path to llama-server; llama-server.exe on Windows), CUTPOINT_LLAMA_BACKEND (llama.cpp build `cutpoint setup` downloads: auto, cuda, vulkan or cpu; default auto), CUTPOINT_VISION_MODEL (Ollama model for `analyze --vision`, default qwen3.5:9b), OLLAMA_HOST (overrides ollama_url), and the assistant's API keys, read only by `cutpoint ui`: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY and XAI_API_KEY (each only for its own official host: api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, api.x.ai) and CUTPOINT_ASSISTANT_API_KEY (custom base URLs only; never sent to those three official hosts).
